channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Katy graduate remembers legendary coach Mike Johnston's transformative impact on Tigers football
item.description: Legendary Katy High School football coach is remembered by Joe Glenn Hyde from the Class of 1982.

item.title: Houston-based Francesca's to close all stores
item.description: Francesca's, a Houston-based women's specialty retailer operating boutiques in shopping centers nationwide, including Katy, appears to be shutting down.

item.title: Early voting underway in Katy City Council Ward A special election; filing begins for May races
item.description: Early voting began Tuesday in the Ward A special city council election between Paula Taylor, a Katy High School teacher, and Cara Bonin, a contractor.

item.title: Katy-Fulshear home sales up 7% in 2025 as inventory grows
item.description: The Katy-Fulshear housing market shifted to a more normal pace in 2025 after several years of rapid price increases, with more homes for sale, lower priced inventory and homes taking longer to sell.

item.title: Katy ISD Adds Fall Break to School Calendars After Community Survey
item.description: Katy ISD Board of Trustees approved fall breaks for the 2026-27 and 2027-28 school years following community feedback. See key dates for both calendars including start dates, holidays and breaks.

item.title: Taylor Mustangs Win First State Cheer Title as Katy ISD Places Four Teams in Top 10
item.description: Taylor High School Mustangs capture first state cheerleading championship in school history at UIL 6A Division I Spirit Championship. Katy ISD places four teams in top 10.

item.title: CenterPoint Energy stages 3,300 workers, equipment in Houston region for expected overnight freeze
item.description: CenterPoint Energy has positioned approximately 3,300 frontline workers, including additional resources brought in from outside the region, at two staging sites in the northern Houston area.

item.title: Multi-alarm fire at Richmond apartments displaces dozens, injures 3
item.description: Three people were taken to the hospital and dozens of residents were displaced after a multi-alarm apartment fire early Saturday morning, according to the Richmond Fire Department.

item.title: National Weather Service Forecast: Next 7 Days
Tesla Megapack Facility Leads Record Year for Waller County Economic Development
item.description: Tesla's 1.2 million-square-foot Megapack manufacturing facility, Grundfos' 150,000-square-foot expansion, and two new TMEIC plants headlined a record-breaking 2025 for the Waller County Economic Development Partnership.
